title: Small-parameter bound from a critical point
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $\epsilon>0$, $0\le p_0\le p_c$, $p_c\in(0,1)$, the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ equals $1/2$, and $p_0\le(2\epsilon)^2p_c$. Then the polynomial at $p_0$ is at most $\epsilon$.
